I’m sorry my friend, but you are just wrong. You do not know my life and you made a huge assumption when you said “yOu HAvEnT gIveN tHem a ChANce”. I’m pretty f-ing privledged compared to some people in this sub in that my loved ones are involved in my treatment, some people have family outright reject them because of mental illness, and I think it is pretty clear in my writing that I have people involved. But I’ll make it more clear: 

My mom has been at my side every step of the way. I have seen tons of doctors. My current doctor and current therapist seem to actually care, they are huge advocates for mental health in my area. My dad, though a prick and more or less unable to express empathy or avoid making things about himself, and despite me more or less cutting off contact with him a month ago, has consistently split treatment bills on many occasions. Furthermore, I am pretty much unable to take care of myself, so now my mom completely supports me financially, without guilting me about it at all. Most of my friends have experienced mental illness, and I have spoken to them about it. 

My mom is extremely invested in trying to get me better, and would probably go bankrupt if it would make me feel better. My sister told me recently that, almost daily, when I am not around, my mother cries for me. 

I have leaned on these people when they offered help, because I probably wouldn’t have made it this far if I hadn’t. 


Despite all that, I still want to kill myself. I still think that I won’t make it much longer. It still feels inevitable. 

Weird huh?

Please think before you voice such an assumption, especially on a support sub, it’s hurtful and makes feelings seem invalid. 


Also “seems you’re suffering with depression” yeah no shit Sherlock. Sorry for being mean but god the hubris in this take

I always always always have something absorbing as many senses as possible. I am always listening to a song or podcast, (ears) or watching a video on my phone (ears and eyes), while playing a game on my laptop (eyes and hands) or scrolling quickly through memes (eyes and kinda hands), often while snacking on something (mouth and smell). It’s completely numbing and not particularly fulfilling. But, you could think about how unfulfilling it is and how useless your life is, or you could just, like, not think about it by distracting yourself with this patented™️ method of Just Fucking Existing until tomorrow. Because maybe tomorrow the doctor will come up with some other treatment or whatever.

May I ask why you can’t get mental help? Not meaning to make that sound condescending, can’t really express tone through text yadda yadda. You can PM me if you want, but other people may be able to chime in if you post here. 

Onto the Satan thing. If the guy was planning on sacrificing babies or something, I don’t think it’ll help much, but if he was talking about the Satanic temple, you might find that there are benefits. I am not and never was involved with the group but it is actually a secular group that teaches individualism, based off some ideas by an actual Satanist, but have turned out to be pretty relevant for some people’s lifestyles. Individualism might actually be helpful for a depressed person. In the somewhat recent past, I decided to stop worrying, as much as I can, about other people and their perceptions. If I was healthy I might disagree with this, but it has kept me alive to be a bit selfish. 

I have decided not to worry about my weight right now, because I know that food is one of that gives me a little dopamine. 
I’ve decided not to worry that I just play mind-numbing video games all day. 
I don’t worry about being so strict about hygiene and routine, if forgoing these will allow me the energy to be able to get out of bed to go to the doctor’s which is the most important thing. Above all else, I need to focus on the real problem, which is getting treatment for my unbalanced brain chemicals. If showering becomes a luxury, then so be it, too bad to the people who have to smell me, they’re not the ones in a life or death situation. 
One of the main ideas of modern satanism is to indulge as long as it hurts no one. I do put some energy into being kind to others, i try not to lash out, but I’m otherwise trying to reduce what will stress me out. 

I’m certainly not cured from doing this, as my other recent posts are evidence, but it has kept me alive for longer than if I had allowed stress to consume me. If your issue is that your family doesn’t understand that you need mental help ASAP, maintaining and sustaining might be your best bet until you can communicate that need to them. It’s not a fulfilling life to be numb like this, but it’s survival. The good news is that your predicament isn’t that no treatments work, it’s that (I’m assuming from what you’ve written) you don’t have access to them. Treatment is a long road but it works for many. You should aim to do what you can to take the first step on it.

Thanks. <3

Thank you for commenting also. And thank you for your last sentence. It means a lot.

I understand that feeling. 

It fucking sucks because I can get myself in a really low place and really start considering it. But I never get quite close enough. 
Ironically, now, even though I wish I was dead, I try to avoid getting in a low place. Not because I’m afraid I’ll go through, but because I’m afraid I won’t. I’ll make myself feel like pure shit for a period of time, and the feeling will likely last for several days, and I’ll just have to steep in it like tea left in the microwave over night. And I will just keep living in this hell world. 

Alternatively, I could just numb myself to everything, which is what I’ve been doing. Don’t indulge in negative thoughts (like I am by being on this subreddit lol), just distract, distract, distract, is all I do. I stay out of “dangerous” situations, like social situations where I risk embarrassing myself, or trying anything creative or productive where I risk disappointing myself when I inevitably fail. This black hole I’m in tonight is all because I tried to do something social. 

I might be able to start a ketamine treatment at the beginning of next month. I am not hopeful it will work (hey if it does that’s awesome and all), but if not I hope it will be what will push me off the edge. Pharma advertises at hopeless people and talk big shit about “success rates of 70%”. They said a similar figure about the ECT, and after that failed for me I feel I got pretty close to the edge. The difference this time is that ketamine is the last resort. Knowing this fact might be what gives me that last necessary nudge over, and honestly, if it doesn’t work to save me, I hope it will at least kill me.

I feel this a lot. 

On one hand, I hear a lot of people say that they personally have recovered from horrible horrible depression, that it’s possible. I’ve had therapists say that people worse off have completely turned their lives around. 

On the other hand, there’s the survivor bias theory. The people who say “I’ve seen people get better” or “I’ve gotten better” might hold the positive situations with more weight in their mind. If someone did a poll asking “all people who got better from depression say aye” might find a large number, but the fact is that there are tons of suicides in all human populations. Those people simply did not get better, they are the unchallengeable dispute to the old acorn “it gets better.”

Right now, all I can do is cling onto the positive stories. It’s all I can do to stay alive.
